overview: This file traces Japan’s Diet from 1947 to 1949 through draft legislation, prime ministers’ addresses, legislative records, and U.S. diplomatic reporting. It documents tax reform, industrial recovery, trade corporations, government reorganization, fiscal policy, foreign affairs debates, and reactions to parliamentary proceedings.
interest: Draft bills, legislative tallies, speeches, and press reactions reveal how Japanese reforms were debated and assessed under occupation.
